blocks.title: What is 52²? Say It in 3 Seconds!
blocks.body:
Teacher writes: 52² = ?
A Vedic student instantly says: 2704!

How? There's a beautiful Vedic shortcut for squaring ANY number. We already know squaring numbers ending in 5. Now let's learn Duplex Method for ANY number!
blocks.body_hi:
शिक्षक लिखते हैं: 52² = ?
एक वैदिक छात्र तुरंत कहता है: 2704!

कैसे? किसी भी संख्या का वर्ग निकालने के लिए एक सुंदर वैदिक शॉर्टकट है। हम पहले से ही 5 पर समाप्त होने वाली संख्याओं का वर्ग जानते हैं। अब किसी भी संख्या के लिए डुप्लेक्स विधि सीखते हैं!

blocks.title: Squaring Using (a+b)² Formula
blocks.body:
Trick 1 — Nearest Round Number Method:

For 52²: Think 52 = 50 + 2
  (a+b)² = a² + 2ab + b²
  50² + 2(50)(2) + 2² = 2500 + 200 + 4 = 2704 ✓

For 48²: Think 48 = 50 - 2
  (a-b)² = a² - 2ab + b²
  50² - 2(50)(2) + 2² = 2500 - 200 + 4 = 2304 ✓

Trick: Choose the NEAREST round number (50, 100, etc.) as base!

blocks.title: Anurupyena Sutra for Squaring
blocks.body:
Shortcut for squaring any 2-digit number (ab):

  ab² = a² | 2ab | b²
  (handle carries right-to-left)

Example: 34²
  a=3, b=4
  a² = 9
  2ab = 24
  b² = 16

  = 9 | 24 | 16
  → 16 → write 6, carry 1
  → 24+1=25 → write 5, carry 2
  → 9+2=11 → write 11
  = 1156 ✓

blocks.title: Square Root Shortcut
blocks.body:
Practice squaring these numbers Vedically:
1. 23² = ?
2. 47² = ?
3. 56² = ?
4. 78² = ?
5. 92² = ?

Answers: 529, 2209, 3136, 6084, 8464

Bonus: Can you spot the ONES DIGIT pattern?
Ones digit of n² only depends on ones digit of n!
1²→1, 2²→4, 3²→9, 4²→6, 5²→5, 6²→6, 7²→9, 8²→4, 9²→1
